approach: The failure class is: the landing step never checks that the running build can read the config it just landed, and the first fix (job 20261101-085726-z7dg) put that check in only one place: the single-reason stop path. The check `Steps::config_after_landing` runs in `State::land`, but its effect is keyed on the stop reason. `set_stop` keeps the first reason, so when another worker already set a stop (repeated failure, requested, budget, rebuilt), the NeedsReinstall stop is dropped. `finish` then rates against a config this build cannot parse, and the end-of-run note is skipped. The fix is to treat `State.unreadable_config` as the single fact: (a) `finish` skips rating whenever it is `Some`; (b) report assembly in `drain_with` forces `Stop::NeedsReinstall` and emits the reinstall note whenever it is `Some` (except `RebuildFailed`, whose build output matters more), and records any overridden `failed_item` in a note; (c) a rebuild that happens after the landing clears it and replaces only a NeedsReinstall stop with Rebuilt. The read goes through one shared helper, `JobConfig::unreadable_at` in capability.rs, used by `RealSteps::config_after_landing` and by the non-drain `athena land` command in main.rs, which prints the same reinstall note. Reinstall wording is a single `drain::reinstall_note(why)`. Tests: a concurrent-drain test (a second worker's repeated failure lands first, then an unreadable-config landing) and a class test across the stub, the parallel stub at bounds 1 and 2, and RealSteps with a real committed athena.toml, for several kinds of unreadable config plus a readable control. CHANGELOG records the root cause.

decisions.choice: Key skip-rating, the reinstall note and the final stop on State.unreadable_config.is_some(), not on the stop reason; NeedsReinstall overrides any earlier stop except RebuildFailed when the report is assembled.
decisions.reason: The fault is that the fact (landed config unreadable) and the stop reason are two things, and set_stop's first-wins rule lets another worker's reason hide the fact. Keying on the fact fixes every ordering of workers at the one place the fact is stored. Overriding at report assembly keeps set_stop's first-wins rule for all other reasons, and workers already stop once any reason is set.

rejected.option: Make set_stop let NeedsReinstall replace the stored reason at landing time
rejected.why: It would also need to special-case Rebuilt/RebuildFailed and still leaves finish and the note keyed on the stop reason; two places to keep in agreement.

rejected.option: Keep the check keyed on the stop and only add a test
rejected.why: That is the instance fix; the concurrent ordering stays broken.

decisions.choice: Keep a genuinely failed item visible: when NeedsReinstall replaces RepeatedFailure, clear failed_item and add a note naming the item.
decisions.reason: The job lines still show the rejected outcome; the run's reason to stop is the reinstall, which is the action the operator must take first. Nothing is lost.

rejected.why: The brief requires the run not to end as 'repeated failure' in this case, and the reinstall would be hidden again.

decisions.choice: Add JobConfig::unreadable_at(git, commit) -> Option<String> in capability.rs and use it from both the drain's RealSteps and `athena land`.
decisions.reason: One definition of 'the running build cannot read the landed config' for every path that lands, drain or not; error text kept for the note.

rejected.option: Make the parser tolerant of unknown keys
rejected.why: Out of scope and weakens the strict schema that protects the job's base config (D38).
Out of scope; and the rebuild path already exists for BUILD_PATHS landings.

decisions.reason: Every Steps impl funnels through Drain::land under the landing lock, so one check covers all; the class test proves it for several impls rather than one.

steps: capability.rs: add `JobConfig::unreadable_at(git: &Git, commit: &str) -> Option<String>` returning `JobConfig::at(...).err().map(|e| format!("{e:#}"))`, with a doc comment naming the root cause (a landing can make the config unreadable for the running build, and nothing checked).

drain.rs: add `pub fn reinstall_note(why: &str) -> String` holding the existing note wording ("the landed athena.toml could not be read by this build ({why}); the job is landed and no failure is counted. Reinstall Athena (./setup.sh in the checkout) and run `athena drain` again"). Change RealSteps::config_after_landing to head() then JobConfig::unreadable_at (head error text kept as Some).

drain.rs finish(): replace `matches!(stop, NeedsReinstall)` with `self.st().unreadable_config.is_some()`. In the rebuilt branch clear unreadable_config and, only if the stored stop is NeedsReinstall, replace it with Rebuilt (keep any other worker's earlier reason). Still return without rating while unreadable.

drain.rs drain_with report assembly (before the Rebuilt/restart block): if unreadable_config is Some and stop != RebuildFailed, set stop = NeedsReinstall; if the replaced stop was RepeatedFailure push a note naming failed_item and clear failed_item; push reinstall_note(why) whenever the final stop is NeedsReinstall. Update the module doc paragraph (~117) and Stop::NeedsReinstall comments: root cause is that the landing never checked that the running build can read what it lands; the check is on the unreadable-config state, not the first stop reason.

risks.risk: The concurrent test depends on thread timing (the other worker's failure must be stored before the unreadable landing).
risks.mitigation: The landing job's run waits on a log entry written by the other worker, then sleeps 30 ms; the only race left is microseconds. A wrong order makes the test pass on base, not fail on the change, so confirm failure on base once while developing.

risks.risk: Overriding RepeatedFailure hides a real failure.
risks.mitigation: Job lines still show the rejected outcome, and a note names the failed item; the item stays queued for the next run.

risks.risk: Any parse error is taken as 'newer schema' (kept from the earlier job).
risks.mitigation: The error text stays in the note so other damage is visible; stated in the docs.

risks.risk: Changing the tests/drain.rs Shared stub breaks existing parallel tests.
risks.mitigation: New fields default to empty/None via Default; the rate() log line is additive and existing tests assert on specific entries (position, started filter) not whole-log equality for those tests — producer reruns the module.

risks.risk: Large files (drain.rs, tests/drain.rs, CHANGELOG.md) hard to edit.
risks.mitigation: Edits are local to named functions; read only the touched ranges.

demonstrations.method: New test `a_landing_with_an_unreadable_config_after_another_workers_stop_is_landed_and_ends_with_reinstall` in mod parallel of crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs. Entry point: public `drain::drain_concurrent(&Shared, limits, &Quiet, 2)`. Precondition: plan has two independent items; `[parallel]` bound 2. Seam: the existing `Shared` stub is extended (step 4) with `unreadable_for: Vec<&str>` (answers `Steps::config_after_landing` with a parse-error text for those jobs, the production check is not in the stub), `wait_for: Vec<(&str,&str)>` (a job's run spins up to 5 s until a log entry appears, plus its run_ms, so the other worker's two rejections and its set_stop come first) and `rate` logging 'rate'. Item `bad` is rejected twice (RepeatedFailure set by worker 2); item `new` lands with the unreadable config. Asserts: report.stop == NeedsReinstall, != RepeatedFailure; `new` landing == "landed" and outcome 'passed'; the log has no 'rate'; a note contains the stub's parse error, 'Reinstall Athena' and 'athena drain'; failed_item None and a note names `bad`; text lacks 'repeated failure'.
demonstrations.observes: Passes with the change; on the base tree report.stop is RepeatedFailure, 'rate' is in the log and no reinstall note exists.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without keying on State.unreadable_config, set_stop(NeedsReinstall) is ignored because RepeatedFailure is already stored, finish rates the unreadable config, and the report ends as repeated failure with no reinstall note.
demonstrations.seam: Entry `drain::drain_concurrent` exists (drain.rs:2653). `Shared` stub exists in tests/drain.rs mod parallel (~6157); the new fields and a `rate` log line are added by plan step 4. The logic under test (Drain::land, finish, report assembly) stays in production code; the stub only supplies the read error and timing.

demonstrations.method: New test `every_landing_path_ends_in_reinstall_for_any_unreadable_config` in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs. A table of unreadable-config causes (unknown top-level key, unknown section, wrong value type) is run through each landing path: the serial `Stub` via `drain::drain`, `Shared` at bounds 1 and 2 via `drain_concurrent`, and `RealSteps` with `ConfigLander` committing a real athena.toml (fixture exists: Fixture, test_config, rated_scenario, work_everything). A shared helper asserts the same outcome for each: stop NeedsReinstall, job landed and 'passed', no 'rate' call, note carries the error text, no failure counted. A readable control (e.g. test_config with max_concurrency changed, via ConfigLander and via the stubs with no unreadable text) must not end in NeedsReinstall and must be rated. A second test `unreadable_at_reports_what_the_running_schema_rejects` calls `JobConfig::unreadable_at` on a Fixture repo before and after committing each bad config (Some with error text, then None for a readable one). main.rs gets a small helper test for the `athena land` note (step 6).
demonstrations.observes: All paths yield the same reinstall outcome; the readable control continues normally and is rated.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the shared state-keyed handling, the paths that run with an earlier stop set (Shared bound 2 case with a prior stop) and the rebuilt/clear logic diverge; without `unreadable_at`, the test does not compile; a regression that checks only the first stop reason or only one steps type fails one of the rows.
demonstrations.seam: Entries `drain::drain`, `drain::drain_concurrent`, `RealSteps` with a `Lander` impl (ConfigLander exists in tests/drain.rs ~2641) and `JobConfig::unreadable_at` (added by step 1). The stub's unreadable text is injected through the existing `config_unreadable_after_landing` field and the new `Shared` field; the RealSteps arm uses the real production parse, the stub arms only supply the error string.
